aliases: credit card in the lost wallet

when.quote: When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card, there is a risk that other cards in their wallet were also compromised.

starts.note: agent: once the lost or stolen debit card has been frozen or closed, the agent checks for Rho-Bank credit cards and proactively offers a replacement. Order a replacement only if the customer accepts.
starts.quote: If yes, proactively offer to order a replacement credit card as a security precaution

info.about: Whether each of the customer's Rho-Bank credit cards was also in the lost or stolen wallet
info.ask: I see you also have a credit card with us. Was that card also in your lost wallet?
Would you like standard or expedited shipping for the replacement credit cards?

info.about: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired or other
info.ask: What is the reason for the replacement?

info.about: Where to ship the replacement credit card: the primary or an alternate address, with any unit or suite
info.ask: Should we ship it to your address on file?

steps.do: Check whether the customer has any Rho-Bank credit cards, and read each one's account id, card type (tier) and status.
steps.if: a lost or stolen debit card has been frozen or closed
steps.quote: Use get_credit_card_accounts_by_user to retrieve any credit card accounts for the customer.

steps.do: If the customer has no active Rho-Bank credit card, skip the rest of this job.
steps.if: check_cc returns no active credit card
steps.quote: Check if the customer has any Rho-Bank credit cards on file

steps.do: Mention the credit card and ask whether it was also in the wallet. Explain that wallet theft often involves several cards, and offer a replacement with a new number.
steps.if: the customer has an active credit card
steps.quote: Offer to order a replacement credit card with a new card number to prevent any unauthorized charges

steps.do: If the customer declines, note that the offer was made, and order nothing.
steps.quote: If they decline, note in the account that the offer was made

steps.do: Unlock the pending replacement orders tool.
steps.quote: To check if a credit card account has any pending replacement card orders, use the get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool.

steps.do: Check each credit card account being replaced for pending replacement orders.

args.credit_card_account_id: each credit card account id from check_cc

steps.quote: To check if a credit card account has any pending replacement card orders, use the get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool.

steps.do: If an order is still pending or shipped, or the tier's 60-day limit (Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium and above 4) is reached, explain that a new replacement cannot be submitted now. Do not unlock or call the order tool.
steps.quote: You cannot submit another replacement while an existing request is still being processed.

steps.do: Confirm the address and reason. Recommend expedited shipping for stolen or fraud_suspected, and state the expedited fee by tier: Entry (e.g. EcoCard, Bronze) $15, Mid $10, Premium and above (e.g. Gold) $0. Get the customer's consent to any fee.
steps.if: the customer accepts and cc_eligibility passed
steps.quote: - If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping to minimize exposure and remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity.

steps.do: Unlock the credit card replacement tool.
steps.if: the customer accepts the replacement and cc_eligibility passed

steps.do: Order a replacement for each card the customer accepted, with the confirmed details. Strongly recommend expedited shipping when the card was stolen.

args.account: the credit card account id from check_cc
args.reason: stolen or lost (as the customer said)
args.expedited_fee_acknowledgement: customer consent if a fee applies

steps.if: the customer accepts the replacement and cc_eligibility passed
steps.quote: Use call_discoverable_agent_tool with tool_name: order_replacement_credit_card_7291 and include:

steps.do: Tell the customer the old card is cancelled, give the delivery window (standard 7-10, expedited 2-3 business days), and remind them to review their transactions. If the order returned an error, explain it instead.
steps.quote: - The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

rules.rule: After handling a lost or stolen debit card, always check for credit cards and offer a replacement if any exist
rules.quote: If yes, proactively offer to order a replacement credit card as a security precaution

rules.rule: If the customer has a credit card, proactively offer a replacement as a security precaution
rules.quote: 3) If yes, proactively offer to order a replacement credit card as a security precaution

rules.rule: For a stolen or fraud_suspected card, strongly recommend expedited shipping and remind the customer to review recent transactions
rules.quote: If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping to minimize exposure and remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity.

rules.rule: Expedited fee: Entry tier (EcoCard, Bronze) $15.00; Mid tier $10.00; Premium tier and above (Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite) $0.00
No new replacement while one is pending. Limits per 60 days: Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium and above 4.
rules.quote: - Replacement requests are limited within a 60-day period to help protect your account.

rules.rule: Do not unlock or call the order tool unless the customer is eligible
rules.quote: Confirm eligibility for replacement in the knowledge base before proceeding. Do not unlock or call the tool unless the customer is eligible.

rules.rule: Freeze or close the debit card first, then do the credit card check
rules.quote: Complete the standard debit card freeze/close procedure

done_when: The credit card check is done. If the customer has a credit card, the replacement offer has been made, and one of these is true: it was ordered with agreed shipping and fees; it was explained as not possible now; or it was declined and noted.
